user_query: My company is hosting a cat adoption event and we need some interesting cat facts to engage potential adopters. Can you provide a random cat fact? Furthermore, recommend a proxy request to fetch 'https://www.catadoptiontips.com' for adoption-related information. Additionally, suggest some apps for pet care and adoption.
